youtube_description:
Skhathisomusa Mthembu, a physics master’s student at the University of the Witwatersrand in Johannesburg and employee of CERN, the European Center for Nuclear Research, describes how to reduce the complexity of AI challenges.

From the AI Advance event at the Berkman Klein Center, May 15, 2017. For more information visit: https://cyber.harvard.edu/research/ai
youtube_title: Skhathisomusa "Scotty" Mthembu on How to Describe the Complex Challenge of AI
